radiometric_policy.name: per_image_p995_white_v101
radiometric_policy.output: uint8 with half-up rounding and clipping

cost_basis.rule: 1.5× (twice v99 outside time and load, plus 48 worst direct and 48 double-worst treatment rows) + 5 seconds.

scope: Exact v100 metadata-only cohort, already observed as development; 24 positives and 24 matched nonoverlaps.
timing_scope: Both fresh arms have identical observation logging, 24 renders and nine instrumented pose calls per successful inference.
